invite.subject: You're invited to the {portal}
invite.title: Welcome, {name}
invite.body: An account has been created for you on the {company} employee portal. Set your password to get started.
invite.text:
Welcome, {name}.

Set your password for the {company} employee portal:
{link}

This link expires in {hours} hours.

reset.subject: Reset your password
reset.title: Password reset
reset.body: Hi {name}, we received a request to reset your password.
reset.expires: This link expires in 1 hour. If you did not request it, you can ignore this email.

changed.subject: Your password was changed
changed.title: Password changed
changed.body: Hi {name}, your password was just changed. If this wasn't you, contact HR immediately.

leaveSubmitted.title: Leave request from {name}
leaveSubmitted.body: {name} requested {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} of {type} ({start} – {end}). Please review it.

leaveSubmittedSelf.title: {type} request submitted
leaveSubmittedSelf.body: Your request was sent for approval ({chain}).

leaveStepApproved.title: {type} approved by your manager
leaveStepApproved.body: {actor} approved your {type} ({start} – {end}). It now needs HR approval.

leaveNextApproverHr.title: Leave request from {name} needs HR approval
leaveNextApproverHr.body: {name}'s {type} ({start} – {end}, {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}) was approved at the previous step.

leaveNextApproverYou.title: Leave request from {name} needs your approval
leaveNextApproverYou.body: {name}'s {type} ({start} – {end}, {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}) was approved at the previous step.

leaveReminder.title: Reminder: leave request waiting {days} days
leaveReminder.body: {name}'s {type} ({start} – {end}) is still waiting for your decision.

leaveEscalated.title: Escalated: leave request waiting {days} days
leaveEscalated.body: {name}'s {type} ({start} – {end}) has not been decided by the manager. You can act on it as HR.

leaveBalanceAdjusted.title: Your {type} balance was adjusted
leaveBalanceAdjusted.body: HR adjusted your {type} balance for {year} by {days} days. Reason: {reason}

leaveDelegation.title: {actor} delegated leave approvals to you
leaveDelegation.body: From {start} to {end} you can approve leave for {actor}'s team.

payslipReady.title: Your {month} payslip is ready
payslipReady.body: Your payslip for {month} has been released. Open it to view or download the PDF.
